doc.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022

title: Commissions and her own ideas
summary: She asks commissioners about instrumentation, sometimes misses the mark, and keeps books of ideas for her own tunes.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: If you got a phone call from some group, I know you’ve done commissions, I saw a thing about a commission you and Randy did. And if they ask you to write something and they don’t give you any guidelines for instrumentation. Is there something you do to try to inspire something to get started?

Well the tune should already give me some input but usually I ask, you know, if they want a full horn section or just some — how many horns — just to have an idea of the sounds they want. And I ask, you know, do you hear kind of like Tower of Power or just kind of more kind of like traditional writing or — just to have an idea of what they want. But it happens sometimes that I wrote something that I thought was good and they didn’t went for it. You know. It’s normal. They say well it’s just — you know I was thinking of a little more traditional. Okay. You know sometimes also people that commission, they don’t have a clear idea so they kind of, you write something and then you realize that they couldn’t word out what they want but then they write and they say that’s not what I want. Okay, so you know it’s like okay I need to go to the other direction. And it happens. Or sometimes it happens that, you know, they don’t tell you anything and they hear, it was like I would have never have thought to — thinking about some horn section or some arrangement like that, but I love it. So go figure.
I would imagine sometimes you’d have something that’s already partly written and you can go ahh — I might be able to use this thing that’s been floating around.

Well that’s when I do it for my own tunes because I have like bars here — I have books and books of little ideas and a computer filled with like logic file with three million tunes ideas. But for other people usually I just go fresh. I enter the tune as a new thing so what I hear. And you know there are clearly some gimmick that I notice that I use harmonically- wise or rhythmically that I notice like I always do some of this. But maybe it’s my trademark.
